title: Urban Chaos Album Art
coreRelationships: The central figure on the sofa is positioned as an observer of the chaos unfolding outside the window.
The painted text on the window acts as a barrier and a commentary on the background scene.
The contrast between the calm, dark foreground and the bright, chaotic background creates a sense of tension.
The elements of luxury (car, jewelry, money) are juxtaposed with the destruction and unrest.
reuseFormula: Create a scene with a central figure in a dark, calm interior, observing a chaotic, brightly lit urban exterior through a large, defaced window. Overlay custom, expressive text on the window and functional sans-serif text for supporting details.
